column1: # libtcg path <TAB> upstream QEMU path, as of the tag recorded in BASELINE.
# Only files that track upstream appear here. S2E-original files
# absent: they have no upstream counterpart to merge from.
# The platform-independent utilities live in libutils; see
# libutils/scripts/upgrade/mapping.tsv for their rows. The merge driver is
# scripts/upgrade/merge.sh at the S2E source root.
# What is left of the old utils/ subset: everything platform-independent
# moved to libutils. cpu-float.h needs the softfloat types, and bswap.h and
# log.c test TARGET_* / CONFIG_SYMBEX macros, so all three stay here.
# Heavily reduced S2E-specific subsets, still v8.1.0-era: these are hand
# written rather than vendored, so merge by hand, not mechanically.
